facts.text: Located in Palmer, Alaska Bible College is Alaska's only accredited four-year Bible college, holding institutional accreditation from the Association for Biblical Higher Education.

sources.title: Alaska Bible College: Accredited Bible College in Alaska
sources.quote: Study Scripture, grow in Christ, and prepare for ministry at Alaska's only accredited four-year Bible college, with study in Palmer and online.

sources.title: Online Bible Certificate - Alaska Bible College
sources.quote: Alaska Bible College is institutionally accredited by the Association for Biblical Higher Education. Full accreditation and authorization details are available on the Accreditation page.
